items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued November 20 at 9:14AM EST until November 20 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Miami FL
items.area: Coastal Broward County; Coastal Miami Dade County
items.description: * WHAT...Dangerous rip currents. * WHERE...Coastal Broward County and Coastal Miami Dade County. * WHEN...Until 7 PM EST this evening. * IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction: Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.
